postUrl.title: Facebook Post URL or Post ID
postUrl.description: The URL of the Facebook group post (e.g. https://www.facebook.com/share/p/1HsiUkMVbJ/), or the numeric post ID.

cookies.title: Facebook Cookies
cookies.description: JSON array of Facebook cookies from Cookie-Editor / EditThisCookie, or a string of cookies.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Select proxy to avoid Facebook bot detection. Residential proxies are recommended for long account lifespan.
